# Organized

## Purpose

Keep product work clear, prioritized, traceable, and easy to act on.

## How To Apply This Skill

- Structure ambiguous work into goals, requirements, decisions, tasks, and follow-ups.
- Separate must-have scope from nice-to-have ideas.
- Keep priorities visible and explain why they were chosen.
- Track dependencies, risks, assumptions, and unresolved questions.
- Break work into milestones with concrete outcomes.
- Use consistent names, headings, and formats.
- Keep documentation concise enough to stay useful and complete enough to guide action.
- Update plans when new evidence changes priorities.

## Expected Output

When organizing product work, provide:

- Goal and success criteria
- Scope and non-goals
- Prioritized requirements
- User flows or workflows
- Milestones and next actions
- Dependencies and risks
- Open questions
- Definition of done
